text: This report is to provide the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority with information and a recommendation regarding a proposed settlement with G4S Secure Solutions (Canada) Ltd., (G4S). Confidential Attachment 1 contains information and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Adopted the Confidential Instructions to Staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 15, 202 1) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 15, 2021) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
